{{Quote|I hope you'll forgive the room. It's the best I could do under the circumstances.|Leia Organa Solo to Ooamu Waoabi|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rhysode Room''' was a meeting room in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. It was named after the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ganner Rhysode]], who [[Battle of the World-Well|died in combat]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]]. A large room centered around an expensive [[roo-wood]] serenity table flanked by [[flowfit chair]]s, it contrasted greatly with the sparse decor of the academy. It had automated beverage dispensers, a state-of-the-art [[Holotheater/Legends|holotheater]], and a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] viewing wall that overlooked the academy’s training grounds.<ref name="JK" />  

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] intended to present delegates from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] with a possible new home planet that she and her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had discovered. [[Ooamu Waoabi]], the eldest of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], would have accepted her offer, but the sudden arrival of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] interrupted the proceedings. To prevent a possible [[The Colony|Killik]]-[[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss]] war, Organa Solo mentioned their discovery. Omas and the assembled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then agreed to give the newly discovered world to the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as a replacement for [[Qoribu]], which had been the source of the previous [[Skirmish at Qoribu|dispute]].<ref name="JK" />
